about: Agenda items matched to threads by each thread’s own patterns. An agenda lists what MAY be discussed; a match says a thread’s words are on the agenda, never what will be decided.
method: deterministic: threads.csv `match` + `qualify` - `exclude` on each agenda line (by: words), or the meeting is of a board the thread names (by: board). No model.
